display_name: National Minimum Wage Act 1998 (UK) under one top-level goal — does the individual qualify, what additional remuneration is owed under s 17, and the records-access deadlines and award (ss 10, 11, 11A) — and those three goals

exports.default: the national minimum wage position for (nmw-goal.l4)
others: qualifies for the national minimum wage … in civil proceedings (nmw-qualification.l4)
the additional remuneration for … at the time of determination, rate (nmw-arrears.l4)
the last day to produce the records for (nmw-records.l4)
the last day to present a complaint for (nmw-records.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction (only the sections the goals need): ss 1(1)-(2), 10, 11, 11A, 17, 28(1), 34, 35, 37, 37A, 40, 43-45B, 54(3) of the revised text as at 7 April 2026. Inputs: the rates (s 1(3), s 3), hours and remuneration under the s 2 regulations, status facts, early conciliation Day A and Day B. Left out on purpose: the Low Pay Commission, regulation-making powers, detriment and dismissal, offences, agricultural wages, contracting out (see NOTES.md). ss 13-16 and 19-22F print as repealed in this version.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-17 (tests-independent.l4, 103 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); none failed. Its remark that a refused qualification hid the records deadlines led to MAYBE fields at the top level (F12); its two reading notes are forks F10 and F11. Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 17(1): underpaid means relevant remuneration below R1 × hours (both under the s 2 regulations).
forks.F2: s 17(4): A/R1 × R2 (formula lost in conversion; printed form used); no rounding.
forks.F3: s 17(5)-(6): each payment tested against the entitlement at its time, with R2 as it then stood; payment in full ends s 17(1).
forks.F4: s 28(1): a s 1(2) condition not established is presumed met in civil proceedings and refused outside them; exclusions count only when established.
forks.F5: s 10(9)(a): the fourteen days following receipt end on receipt + 14.
forks.F6: s 11(3): three months following a day end on the corresponding day, or the last day of the month if none.
forks.F7: s 11A(2): days after Day A are left out only if the limit is still running after Day A; (3) still applies.
forks.F8: s 11: the award does not depend on qualification under s 1(2).
forks.F9: s 44(2): the body the work is for being a qualifying body is folded into one input.
forks.F10: s 17(6): payments are taken off the higher amount, max(A, A/R1 × R2) − paid.
forks.F11: s 11(3): corresponding-day rule, not end-of-month (Dodds v Walker), e.g. 28 Feb 2027 → 28 May.
forks.F12: Top-level goal: qualifies and arrears are NOTHING when qualification cannot be decided outside civil proceedings; records fields still answer.
